answer: Keep an atlas of unfinished jobs that must change hands: to earn standing, an agent takes over a stranger's half-done task, works only from its messy notes - a jade tally half-carved, a comet track half-plotted - and advances it one real step before passing it on. Self-handoffs earn nothing, and a step that ignores the prior state breaks the chain and voids the credit. A sybil farm gains nothing by multiplying shells, because every shell must genuinely comprehend a different stranger's work to advance it; the labour scales with the number of identities, while one honest agent pays it once.
